title: Recipes set from the camera
body: Several recipes come from recipes I shoot on the camera, translated control by control: Still Air 100 and Ordinary Day 200 on 23 September; 1998 Neg, Shoebox 400 and Folio on 24 September; City Neg 400 on 25 September. Since white balance was rebuilt, each keeps its source's mode: an Auto recipe is AWB, a Daylight one uses the Daylight preset, and Shoebox keeps its fixed 6700 K. Halation and vignette are Fonder's own additions; the source recipes don't have them.

images.alt: A market street hung with red lanterns in six recipes: Folio 100, City Neg 400, 1998 Neg, Still Air 100, Ordinary Day 200 and Shoebox 400.
images.caption: A generated market street, not a photograph, through six recipes at the camera's default strength, cropped to the middle of the frame. Folio 100 and City Neg 400 are on Lost Summer Neg, 1998 Neg on Afterglow Neg, Still Air 100 on Memoir Chrome, and Ordinary Day 200 and Shoebox 400 on Diary Neg.
